flowRoot.flowPara: • Generating Heat is tied to actions. Movement actions and free actions count, so use that to your advantage.
• Converting Heat to damage with Tinderbolt more efficient than converting it to healing with Dissipation... but dead men deal no damage.
• Pyromania can be devastating, but you need to plan your turn around it. Plan it right and you can play 7 Tinderbolts - and the damage adds up fast.
• To get the most from Cauterizing Brand, boost the damage you deal to yourself with a (S) card.
• If you play it right, Flickerstep will recharge quickly, allowing you to play a little recklessly.
• Ash Augur doesn't look like much on the surface, but it can be key to your strongest combos. Don't be afraid to "waste" Embershield or Wave of Cinder to trigger its free clause.
